patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches.name: Block deep midroll ads
patches.description: Disables the dedicated request_midroll runnable, midpoint configuration, and direct named midroll starts.

patches.name: Block listings
patches.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches.name: Block midroll ads
patches.description: Stops the runtime MIDROLL branch before VideoAutoPlay pauses or switches the main video player to the instream ad engine.

patches.name: Bypass RootBeer root detection
patches.description: Stubs calls into the scottyab/rootbeer native root-checking library so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.

patches.name: Bypass STCrypt CKey root detection
patches.description: Disables the STCrypt/CKey SDK's aggregate root-detection check so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.

patches.name: Bypass VPN check
patches.description: Reduces MAX's external IP-checker fallback list to a single, blockable endpoint.

patches.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches.name: Bypass native signature check
patches.description: Prevents libvkcore.so from terminating re-signed VK Video builds at startup.

patches.name: Custom branding icon
patches.description: Adds a badge to the launcher icon so the patched app is distinguishable from an unpatched install.

patches.name: Disable Adjust
patches.description: Disables Adjust attribution manifest entry points.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest entries.

patches.name: Disable Firebase telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase telemetry collection flags and DataTransport sender entry points.

patches.name: Disable Google Analytics
patches.description: Disables legacy Google Analytics manifest entry points.

patches.name: Disable Kaspersky SDK
patches.description: Disables Sberbank's bundled Kaspersky KAV SDK (background antivirus scanning) manifest entry points.

patches.name: Disable MAX advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID permission so ad and analytics SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.

patches.name: Disable Mine redesign
patches.description: Reverts the Mine screen to the classic layout, disabling the redesigned V2/V3 interface.

patches.name: Disable OpenTelemetry APM
patches.description: Disables the ru.ok.tracer/OpenTelemetry pipeline (OkHttp request interception, CPU/network tech-stats, span/metric/log upload) by forcing its tracing-enabled gate off.

patches.name: Disable Ozon Bank VPN warning
patches.description: Removes the warning shown when Ozon Bank detects an active VPN connection.

patches.name: Disable Ozon Bank advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID permission so AdMob and other ad SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.

patches.name: Disable RuStore metrics
patches.description: Disables RuStore metrics manifest entry points.

patches.name: Disable RuTube advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID permission so ad SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.

patches.name: Disable Sberbank advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID permission so ad and analytics SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.

patches.name: Disable Segment analytics
patches.description: Disables Segment (segment.com) event tracking by no-opping its event-processing entry point.

patches.name: Disable Sentry telemetry
patches.description: Disables Sentry telemetry by turning off SDK auto-init and clearing the DSN.

patches.name: Disable VK Video MyTarget SDK
patches.description: Disables MyTarget's auto-init content provider and ad activity so the SDK never starts.

patches.name: Disable VK Video advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID permission so ad SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.

patches.name: Disable ad pixel tracking
patches.description: Stops PixelStatsTrackerImpl from sending individual and batch ad pixels.

patches.name: Disable ad-free subscription promo
patches.description: Disables VK's VIDEO_AD_FREE_SUBSCRIPTION feature gate so profile promo items are never created.

patches.name: Disable ads

options.title: Hide notification buttons

patches.name: Spoof USB debugging status
patches.description: Spoofs USB debugging and related developer settings through common Android APIs.

patches.name: Spoof VPN status
patches.description: Spoofs VPN state through common Android network APIs.

patches.name: Spoof VPN telemetry field
patches.description: Forces boolean values boxed right after a VPN-flag telemetry key (vpn, is_vpn, is_vpn_on, isVpnConnected, vpn_enabled, vpn_connected) to false, as defense-in-depth alongside Spoof VPN status for apps that cache the VPN flag before reporting it. Default-off: verify against a real decompile of the target app first (see provenance comment).

patches.name: Spoof default proxy and DNS servers
patches.description: Makes ConnectivityManager.getDefaultProxy() return null and LinkProperties.getDnsServers() return an empty list, closing two detection checks not covered by Spoof VPN status (the system-default proxy, and loopback/private DNS server comparison).

patches.name: Spoof emulator status
patches.description: Spoofs emulator state through common Build, QEMU file, command, and system property checks.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description: Spoofs package installer checks to report Google Play as the install source.

patches.name: Spoof installed VPN apps list
patches.description: Makes PackageManager queries for installed VpnService-implementing apps (the android.net.VpnService intent action) return an empty list, hiding which VPN client apps are installed without affecting any other PackageManager query.

patches.name: Spoof network interface MTU
patches.description: Forces NetworkInterface.getMtu() to report the standard Ethernet MTU (1500) instead of a reduced tunnel-typical value, when the call site shows a VPN-detection context.

patches.name: Spoof system proxy properties
patches.description: Makes System.getProperty("http.proxyHost") and the other JVM-level proxy property keys return null, as if no proxy/VPN-provided proxy were configured.

patches.name: UI tweaks
patches.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, optionally hide profile sections (recommendations, tools, services, jobs), and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Unlock subscription features
patches.description: Reports the account as subscribed to the app itself, which enables features gated behind a paid subscription such as background playback. Anything the server enforces is unaffected.
